_comment: Generated from graph/gql.py::TOKENS. Do not hand-edit.
The filter grammar exists in two implementations: the Python engine and
the TypeScript pill mirror. It used to exist in FOUR hand-kept copies and
they taught different things, so this file is the claim both sides assert

tokens.hint: Free text — substring match on node names.
tokens.semantics: An unparseable token becomes this rather than an error, so a half-typed query is harmless. The cost is that a typo'd prefix silently becomes a name search.

tokens.hint: Node entity type; an occurrence's node_type too.
tokens.semantics: An IDENTITY filter: it selects, and never blocks a traversal path.

tokens.hint: occurrence (happened) vs entity (persists).
The slot a node occupied in its occurrence.
tokens.semantics: With `degree>` this becomes role-SCOPED degree, which is how an intermediary is discovered rather than declared: `via` in 340 payments is a finding, 340 connections is a shrug.

tokens.hint: The why axis — who serves this interest.
tokens.semantics: A trailing `+` rolls up through `subsumes` and walks `furthers` backward, so a mundane licensing delay reaches the plan it belongs to. The `+` survives quoting, which matters because interests are multi-word far more often than not.

tokens.hint: Edge predicate.
Restrict to one projection.
tokens.semantics: The scan for every other projection never happens, so this is the cheapest filter in the language.

tokens.hint: Restrict to one section, by its own name.
tokens.semantics: The readable spelling of `field:` — the engine resolves `places` to `document.places[*]` against this run, so nobody has to know the contract's internal path to ask about its content. Same tier, same cost: a skipped projection is a scan that never happens.

tokens.hint: Any column on the exploded row.
tokens.semantics: Numeric comparisons are guarded: a non-numeric value compares as NULL rather than raising.

tokens.hint: A field on the DOCUMENT, not the row.
tokens.semantics: Climbs out of the exploded row to the annotation's own object. The row is what happened; the document is where it was said.

tokens.hint: The node's own name, matched EXACTLY.
tokens.semantics: Exact where bare free text is a substring, because asking for one occurrence by name should not also return nine that merely contain it.

tokens.hint: Edge count on the surviving subgraph.
tokens.semantics: Counts edges whose far end was filtered out, so `role:via degree>20` still answers 'how many payments does this bank route'. Corrupted by corpus mix in a mixed infospace — see WEIGHT(ref:corpus).

tokens.hint: Edge attestation.
How often a node was named.
Interest affinity between two actors, [-1, 1].
tokens.semantics: A cosine over interest profiles, and NOTHING else. It used to be multiplied by a distance penalty, which capped it at 0.5 forever because sharing an interest puts two actors at exactly two hops. Pair with `contact` for the finding.

tokens.hint: Graph distance, in hops, to the actor it converges with.
tokens.semantics: Unreachable pairs pass every floor: no path at all is the STRONGEST form of 'without contact', not a missing value.

tokens.hint: Interval overlap — undated items are KEPT.
Interval overlap — undated items are KEPT.
Within a radius of a geocoded node.
Traversal seed — substring match on node names.
tokens.semantics: Separate `from:` tokens INTERSECT (reachable from BOTH — the co-presence question); commas inside one token union.

tokens.hint: How far to walk. Default 1, max 10.
tokens.semantics: Hops count ACTOR steps — occurrences are contracted, so actor→occurrence→actor is ONE hop. `-origin` and `-paths` each SUBTRACT, in any order.

tokens.hint: The union of several sub-queries.
tokens.semantics: The one grouping form. Composes by intersection with everything else, so ANY(...) type:Organization reads as it looks. A pinned node, edge, cluster and interest are each already a query fragment, which is what makes a pin page one string.
